# Manh Long Optical (Kính mắt Mạnh Long)

> Independent optical shop at 147A Le Duan, Cua Nam, Hanoi, Vietnam. Free eye test, prescription lenses cut in store, roughly a thousand frames. English spoken on every shift. Open daily 8:00–21:30.

## Facts

- Name: Manh Long Optical (Vietnamese: Kính mắt Mạnh Long)
- Address: 147A Lê Duẩn, Cửa Nam, Hà Nội, Vietnam — a short walk from Hanoi railway station
- Coordinates: 21.022849, 105.841554
- Phone / Zalo: +84 777 986 999
- Email: mlong.optical@gmail.com
- Hours: 08:00–21:30, every day
- Languages: Vietnamese and English. English is spoken on every shift.
- Payment: card and cash
- In trade since the early 2000s; twenty-five years supplying frames wholesale before opening to the public

## What is offered

- Free eye test (full refraction), whether or not you buy. Re-checks free for life.
- Lens types: single vision, progressive (multifocal), blue-light filtering, photochromic, prescription sunglasses
- Lens brands stocked: Essilor, ZEISS, Tokai, Elements, Nikki, Chemi
- Frames: acetate, flexible plastic, metal, titanium; large selection of Korean designs. Customers may bring their own frame.
- Aftercare: adjustments, cleaning and nose-pad replacement free for as long as the pair is owned. Manufacturing faults replaced.

## Timing

- Single-vision glasses: usually ready the same day (lenses held in stock, cut in store)
- Standard progressive lenses: about 24 hours
- Essilor or ZEISS progressive lenses: three to four days, because the lens surface is cut to measurement at the manufacturer's lab

## Price

- A finished single-vision pair (frame and lenses): 850,000–3,500,000 VND
- Visitors from abroad typically spend 1,500,000–4,000,000 VND, as they more often choose photochromic, progressive or branded lenses
- Example of a single lens price: Essilor blue-light filtering lens 1,480,000 VND
- Customers who have bought in both places report paying several times more at home, with a one to two week wait rather than a day

- Offers and promotional prices change. The ranges above are typical, not a quotation.
